svg.title: Qwen3-4B decoder layer: operator and tensor dataflow
svg.desc: One autoregressive inference step at position p. Every arrow is labelled with its source tensor equation. Follow query, key and value projections through grouped-query attention, then the SwiGLU feed-forward network. Dashed paths carry the two residual connections. All projections use column vectors and bias-free learned matrices. Layer weights and normalization gains are implicit parameters. The visible KV prefixes are the cache state for the next step.

g.inkscape:label: Page and notation
g.text: One token at position p passes through grouped-query attention and a SwiGLU feed-forward network.
32 query heads (h) · 8 KV heads (g) · 128 features per head
ε = 10⁻⁶. Each of the four norms learns its own gain.
Rθ(a, b) = (a cos θj − b sin θj,
a sin θj + b cos θj)
Pairs (j, j + 64) use phases shared across all layers.
Each query head normalizes over positions 0 through p.
The key and value prefixes include the current token.
